daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Momentum Analysis with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical prices, calculate the 20-day moving average and identify momentum shifts. Write a query using window functions (ROW_NUMBER, LAG) to: 1) Compute closing price moving average for each stock, 2) Calculate day-over-day price change, 3) Rank stocks by momentum (highest positive change) within each date partition, 4) Flag when a stock crosses its 20-day MA (going above or below). Return the top 10 momentum leaders for the most recent date in the dataset, showing stock symbol, date, close price, MA20, price change %, and momentum rank.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Risk Scoring
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (accident records with location, severity, vehicle type). Write a Python/pandas script to: 1) Load the CSV and inspect for missing values, duplicates, and data types, 2) Clean crash severity categories (standardise text case, handle nulls), 3) Extract suburb/LGA from location strings, 4) Create a risk score (1-100) based on crash count, injury severity, and fatality rate by suburb, 5) Export cleaned dataset with risk scores to a new CSV. Output should include a summary report showing data quality metrics (% missing, duplicates removed, records processed).

daily_quests.title: Australian Weather Anomaly Detection Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build an end-to-end pipeline using Bureau of Meteorology weather observations. Step 1 (Python): Load daily temperature/rainfall data for a major Australian city (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane), clean missing values via interpolation, and calculate 30-year climate normals (mean, std dev per date). Step 2 (SQL): Create a temp table of daily observations and load cleaned data. Write a CTE-based query to identify anomalies: days where temperature or rainfall deviates >2 standard deviations from the 30-year normal. Step 3 (Python): Query results back and visualise anomalies in a summary CSV showing date, observed value, normal value, deviation %, and anomaly flag. Process at least 5 years of historical data.
